+"""Duration formatting for logs that require an explicit hour unit."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+def explicit_hour_duration(seconds: float) -> str:
+    """Format the given seconds like :func:`_pytest.terminal.format_node_duration`,
+    but using ``hr`` instead of ``h`` as the hours suffix."""
+    if seconds < 0.00001:
+        return f" {seconds * 1000000:.3f}us"
+    if seconds < 0.0001:
+        return f" {seconds * 1000000:.2f}us"
+    if seconds < 0.001:
+        return f" {seconds * 1000000:.1f}us"
+    if seconds < 0.01:
+        return f" {seconds * 1000:.3f}ms"
+    if seconds < 0.1:
+        return f" {seconds * 1000:.2f}ms"
+    if seconds < 1:
+        return f" {seconds * 1000:.1f}ms"
+    if seconds < 60:
+        return f" {seconds:.3f}s"
+    if seconds < 3600:
+        return f" {seconds // 60:.0f}m {seconds % 60:.0f}s"
+    return f" {seconds // 3600:.0f}hr {(seconds % 3600) // 60:.0f}m"

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from _pytest.explicit_hour_duration import explicit_hour_duration
+from _pytest.terminal import format_node_duration
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "seconds, expected",
+    [
+        (3600, " 1hr 0m"),
+        (3600 * 2 + 61, " 2hr 1m"),
+        (3600 * 100 + 59 * 60, " 100hr 59m"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_explicit_hour_duration_hours(seconds: float, expected: str) -> None:
+    assert explicit_hour_duration(seconds) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "seconds",
+    [-1, 0, 0.000001, 0.00005, 0.0005, 0.005, 0.05, 0.5, 1, 59.9, 60, 3599],
+)
+def test_explicit_hour_duration_matches_below_one_hour(seconds: float) -> None:
+    assert explicit_hour_duration(seconds) == format_node_duration(seconds)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [None, "1", [1]])
+def test_explicit_hour_duration_invalid_input(value: object) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        format_node_duration(value)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        explicit_hour_duration(value)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
